nxt: one that had reached England by way of Mauritius and originally came from Chinese stock.

title: A Strange Berry
text: The banana has one more identity crisis: botanically speaking, a banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not!

nxt: containing three distinct layers: an outer exocarp skin, a fleshy mesocarp, and an inner endocarp encasing the seeds.
